descriptions.exit: newlib exit: runs the registered atexit functions in reverse order, calls the reentrancy cleanup hook if set, then _exit(code).
descriptions.abort: Appears to be SN's abort: calls _exit(1).
descriptions.fiprintf: newlib fiprintf: formats the variable arguments to the stream with vfiprintf.
descriptions.w3d_vfprintf_console_write_802f05f0: SN console writer used by vfprintf: buffers bytes in a 128-byte static buffer and writes it to fd when full or when flush is 1.
descriptions.w3d_vfiprintf_console_write_802f1be0: SN console writer used by vfiprintf: buffers bytes in its own static buffer and writes it to fd when full or when flush is 1.
